capabilities: render timeline blocks with stage, title and description
draw bar, line and doughnut-style pie charts via bundled Chart.js
draw SVG flowcharts with labeled arrows, zoom, panning and full-screen controls
render decision trees from indented branches or named nodes, including cycles as return arrows
fall back to tables or plain text for unknown block types
disambiguation: Not a Pocket (read-it-later service) integration; it renders a custom pocket: block syntax and explicitly does not sync or import Pocket data.
extras: Not yet in the Obsidian Community directory; must be installed manually from GitHub Releases. Android hardware testing of this release is pending, and full-screen support depends on the device.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in renderer for this Pocket block syntax, and its native diagram support does not cover timelines, decision trees or cycle-aware flowcharts.

relations.evidence: Chart.js 4.4.1 and its color dependency are bundled locally under their MIT licenses.

summary: Renders custom pocket: block syntax as timelines, bar/line/pie charts, SVG flowcharts and decision trees in Reading view, fully offline.
